description.subject: A small toy figure with a white, featureless rounded head and white hands, made of molded resin or vinyl and dressed in wool clothing.
description.covering: It wears a crimson wool beanie, a crimson rib-weave sweater with a rolled turtleneck collar and cuffed sleeves that reach the wrists, white trousers with two navy vertical bands down each leg that reach the boot tops, and glossy orange boots.
description.posture: It stands upright with its feet together and its arms hanging at its sides, facing the viewer.
description.setting: It stands on a bed of wet, shiny river stones in charcoal and brown tones, with an out-of-focus wall, a gray post and a few small colored objects in the distance.
description.light: Soft, even, low-contrast light from the front and above in a neutral-to-warm tone, giving wet highlights on the stones and no hard shadows.
description.anomaly: A glossy, translucent orange-red glass bead sits on the front of the sweater at stomach height, as though embedded in the wool.
